dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, are you OK? You look sad.
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, ər juː oʊˈkeɪ? juː ˈlʊk ˈsæd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Mark and I argued last night.
dialogue.reading: ˈmɑːrk ənd aɪ ˈɑːrɡjuːd ˈlæst ˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh no. What did you argue about?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ. ˈwʌt dɪd juː ˈɑːrɡjuː əˈbaʊt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: He forgot our dinner on my birthday. He was playing video games with his friends!
dialogue.reading: hiː fərˈɡɑːt aʊr ˈdɪnər ɑːn maɪ ˈbɜːrθdeɪ. hiː wʌz ˈpleɪɪŋ ˈvɪdioʊ ˌɡeɪmz wɪð hɪz ˈfrɛndz!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's bad. Did you two break up?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈbæd. dɪd juː ˈtuː ˈbreɪk ˈʌp?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, we didn't break up. But we fell out, and now he isn't answering my messages.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, wiː ˈdɪdənt ˈbreɪk ˈʌp. bʌt wiː ˈfɛl ˈaʊt, ənd ˈnaʊ hiː ˈɪzənt ˈænsərɪŋ maɪ ˈmɛsɪdʒɪz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Don't worry. People fall out sometimes, but they usually make up.
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri. ˈpiːpəl ˈfɔːl ˈaʊt ˈsʌmtaɪmz, bʌt ðeɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ˈmeɪk ˈʌp.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: But my last relationship ended after a fight like this.
dialogue.reading: bʌt maɪ ˈlæst rɪˈleɪʃənʃɪp ˈɛndɪd ˈæftər ə ˈfaɪt laɪk ˈðɪs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Every relationship is different. Do you want to make up with him?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛvri rɪˈleɪʃənʃɪp ɪz ˈdɪfərənt. duː juː ˈwɑːnt tə ˈmeɪk ˈʌp wɪð hɪm?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, I do. I already miss him.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈduː. aɪ ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈmɪs hɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then call him and talk. You'll feel better.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈkɔːl hɪm ənd ˈtɔːk. juːl ˈfiːl ˈbɛtər.
